pipeline.description: Run the full Pipeline Orchestrator adaptation flow.
pipeline.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill.

Run the full pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Use structured gates for decisions. Require acceptance evidence, RED test evidence, GREEN test evidence, prompt evidence, adversarial review, and final batch verdict. Do not touch original Claude Code plugin files.

bugfix.description: Run the Pipeline Orchestrator bugfix flow.
bugfix.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill and the pipeline-contracts skill.

Run the bugfix pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Use structured gates before changing behavior. Require the bug to be reproduced with RED evidence, fixed with GREEN evidence, checked with prompt evidence, and reviewed by adversarial review.

bugfix-light.description: Run the lighter Pipeline Orchestrator bugfix flow.
bugfix-light.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill and pipeline-tdd skill.

Run the light bugfix pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Keep scope small, use structured gates only when needed, require RED evidence before the fix, GREEN evidence after the fix, and adversarial review before completion.

bugfix-heavy.description: Run the heavier Pipeline Orchestrator bugfix flow.
bugfix-heavy.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill, pipeline-contracts skill, and pipeline-tdd skill.

Run the heavy bugfix pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Gather context through structured gates, reproduce the failure with RED evidence, fix with GREEN evidence, run prompt evidence, and require adversarial review with security, architecture, and quality checks.

feature-light.description: Run the lighter Pipeline Orchestrator feature flow.
feature-light.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill and pipeline-tdd skill.

Run the light feature pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Define a small vertical slice, use structured gates for unclear requirements, require acceptance evidence, RED evidence, GREEN evidence, prompt evidence, and adversarial review.

feature-heavy.description: Run the heavier Pipeline Orchestrator feature flow.
feature-heavy.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill, pipeline-contracts skill, pipeline-tdd skill, and pipeline-adversarial-review skill.

Run the heavy feature pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Plan explicit slices, use structured gates for scope and safety, require acceptance evidence, RED evidence, GREEN evidence, prompt evidence, adversarial review, and batch transition validation before completion.

audit-light.description: Run the lighter Pipeline Orchestrator audit flow.
audit-light.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill, pipeline-contracts skill, and pipeline-adversarial-review skill.

Run the light audit pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Keep the workflow read-only. Require physical read-only proof, finding evidence, severity justification, adversarial review, and closeout evidence before completion.

audit-heavy.description: Run the heavier Pipeline Orchestrator audit flow.
audit-heavy.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill, pipeline-contracts skill, and pipeline-adversarial-review skill.

Run the heavy audit pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Keep the workflow read-only. Require approved scope evidence, read-only proof, risk matrix evidence across at least three fronts, source artifacts, adversarial report review, and closeout evidence.

ux-light.description: Run the lighter Pipeline Orchestrator UX flow.
ux-light.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill and pipeline-contracts skill.

Run the light UX pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Require persona evidence, main-flow evidence, basic accessibility evidence, visual or flow evidence, adversarial review, and final verdict before completion.

ux-heavy.description: Run the heavier Pipeline Orchestrator UX flow.
ux-heavy.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill, pipeline-contracts skill, and pipeline-adversarial-review skill.

Run the heavy UX pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Require approved persona artifacts, journey artifacts, BDD scenario evidence, visual validation evidence, expanded accessibility evidence, review evidence, and no critical accessibility failure.

spec-light.description: Run the lighter Pipeline Orchestrator SPEC flow.
spec-light.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill and pipeline-contracts skill.

Run the light SPEC pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Require requirements, design, tasks, acceptance traceability, format-gate evidence, adversarial review, and final verdict before completion.

spec-heavy.description: Run the heavier Pipeline Orchestrator SPEC flow.
spec-heavy.template:
Use the pipeline-orchestrator skill, pipeline-contracts skill, and pipeline-adversarial-review skill.

Run the heavy SPEC pipeline for: $ARGUMENTS

Require requirements, DDD, contracts, test strategy, risks, post-implementation gates, acceptance traceability, adversarial spec review, and final verdict evidence.
